question: For instances whose display name matches the pattern 'prime' and are not deleted, and restricting to those running on host "blaze8-12" with more than 8 VCPUs, provide the VM state, display name, number of instances, minimum memory (MB), and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the time (in days) between instance creation and the last update of its instance info cache record. Do not return any rounded answers.
